text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Last one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is having a productive
summer training camp, hitting all
of her
targets with ease.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey! Where do you want to start at
the festival tonight? I'm kinda
feelin' some
candied apples!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget about the grilled carrots! Oh
man, nighttime can't come
soon enough!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone training around us appears to be
in high spirits. I suspect
that has something
to do with the festival that will be taking
place
nearby tonight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why are you staring at me so much? Is
there sand on my face?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? Can you just make
sure to time my next lap
properly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why would I be any different? I'm going to
go for another lap, so
please keep my
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few hours after our training ends, I
wander into the camp lodge.
The halls are
eerily quiet, as most have likely made their
way over to
the festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few hours after our training ends, I
wander into the camp lodge.
The halls are
eerily quiet, as most have likely made their
way over to
the festival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have something to do, and the quiet
environment will help me
concentrate on
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey... By any chance, can you draw
landscapes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not exactly... I'm working on making a
paper play based on the
Veggie Caroline
movie.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, sorry for not being clear. The thing
is... I'm working on making
a paper play
based on the Veggie Caroline movie.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The kids aren't able to go see it
themselves. They're not at an age
where
they can sit still and quiet in a movie
theater, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The kids aren't able to go see it
themselves. They're not at an age
where
they can sit still and quiet in a movie
theater, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I thought I could turn it into a paper
play that they can enjoy as
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've drawn all of the characters, but I'm
nowhere near finished with
the
background landscapes. Even one takes a
considerable time to
draw.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on it, the movie did take
place on an abandoned
island. The
landscapes around here would probably
make for some
great references.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, pictures? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've got access to a coastal area, a
forest, and even this inn
resembles the
abandoned lodge from the movie. This
should work out
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest cutting out her character
illustrations and taking photos of
the
required landscapes with them, thus
creating a paper play with
real-life
scenery.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Are you really just a trainer? That's a great
idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you might be a genius.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All I'll have to do after this is print the
photos out in a larger size and
hang them
up as my backgrounds!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All I'll have to do after this is print the
photos out in a larger size and
hang them
up as my backgrounds!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll have to cut out all the
characters, bring them over to the
beach,
and then take the pictures. Can I actually
do it all before
everyone gets back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I figured you would offer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, I expected the offer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And you're not the type to give up after I
refuse any help. I'm starting
to understand
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I remember before when you said you
would be willing to help me out
with
anything that was troubling me. I was
likely going to ask for your
help directly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's meet in the common room in
five minutes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet in the common area in five
minutes, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We quickly cut out all of the characters,
and we have now begun our
photography.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We quickly cut out all of the characters,
and we have now begun our
photography.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, scooch farther right! Stretch your
arms out as far as you can,
otherwise you'll
be in the picture!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Something up with that window?
Oh, that's another great
idea! If we lean
them up against it we can take the picture
as if they
are standing in the room!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I feel like we need more realism for this
running scene. Trainer, can
you do some
sprints for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you think we should put them there?
Nice idea! It's like the
characters are
hiding in the environment. It should be fun
to have
them try and find them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to wait until tomorrow to take the
daytime photos... So that
means this will
be our last photo of the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to wait until tomorrow to take the
daytime photos... So that
means this will
be our last photo of the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Try not to move, Trainer. Three, two,
one...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Got it. Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang, boom!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I guess that festival's almost over, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If we went now, all the stalls would surely
be closing up shop for the
night. I asked
Ryan and the others to get me some
souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I used to go to festivals with Ryan and the
other girls quite often back
in the day.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there are a lot of people here...
Ryan, you better not let go of
my hand,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they have cotton candy! Ryan, over
there. See the cotton candy?
Hey, let's get
some!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I would hold their hands and drag them all
over the place...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My mother was often busy with work, so I
would spend a lot of my
time playing with
the other Mejiro girls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ryan was the responsible one, and I always
felt at ease around her. I
have a lot of fond
memories of the fun times we had.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So when my sister and brother were born, I
decided that I would try to
be the same
for them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I can somehow make them feel just as
happy and content as I felt
back then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My chances are few and far between now,
however, as I spend most
of my days at the
academy and dorms.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When I do get a chance to see them, I
often don't know how to best
treat them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I ended up drawing a Veggie Caroline
picture last time I was there,
and they
started to beg me to draw more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right. It's something I can do fairly well
and share with them. So now
this is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Palmer always brought out the paper play
theater when we were
younger. Luckily,
she still had it around. I had to rely on one
of my
big sisters one more time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Now just what does that mean?
You're just playing around,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A big sister look? I've never thought of
myself like that... How do I
give it off?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't think so at all! But maybe if they
like the paper play, then
they'll start
viewing me as such, even if it's just a little
bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel like a big sister at all, to be
honest. But maybe if they like
the paper
play, then they'll start viewing me as such,
even if it's just a
little bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I do owe you my gratitude. I'll be
sure to report back on how
it goes after I
return from my upcoming trip.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You've helped me so much with this, so I
feel like I owe you a report
on how it goes
after I return from my upcoming trip.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back. The fireworks seem like
they're wrapping up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back. The fireworks seem like
they're wrapping up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When those two get a little bigger, I
would love to be able to bring
them along
to some festivals as well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Dober gazes up at the fireworks,
she gives a gentle smile. I
can tell that she
loves and cares for her younger siblings
very deeply.
